messages:
josh: quick heads-up — ran a full attention kernel sweep across A100 / H100 / L40S. seq len sweep 512,1024,2048,4096,8192,16384; batch sizes 1,4,8,16,32,64. testing FlashVariants, paged-attn, fused-attn. summary attached below.

josh: top-level observation: H100 shows a surprising p95 latency bump at bs=8 seq=8192 for paged-attn + kvcache enabled. A100/L40S look sane. Throughput also drops ~18% vs previous run.

anya: ugh, that aligns with the canary we saw yesterday. any idea what commit landed before the bump? :thinking_face:

josh: looks like 72f9c8d -> kernel-selector change to prefer fused memcpy for >4096. bisect points to that area.

vikram: can you paste the perf numbers/snippets? helps to see both p50/p95 and tokens/sec.

josh: pasted quick table:
```
GPU   | seq | bs | kernel       | tok/s   | p50(ms) | p95(ms)
H100  | 8192| 8  | paged-attn   | 120k    | 45      | 230   <-- bump
H100  | 8192| 8  | fused-attn   | 147k    | 34      | 78
A100  | 8192| 8  | paged-attn   | 132k    | 39      | 85
L40S  | 8192| 8  | paged-attn   | 118k    | 42      | 88
```

josh: also ran KV cache stress: when kvcache warm set to >1M entries and eviction hits ~3k/s, paged-attn on H100 starts falling back to an extra memcpy which balloons p95. stack shows memcpy stalling on PCIe channel for this workload.

maria: console traces show repeated kernel-selector flips around token 1024 boundary for the same request, which could cause context switches in runtime. snapshot: `selector: prefuse -> fused-memcpy -> prefuse` every 1.2s.

anya: sounds like a churn loop. maybe selector heuristics oscillate because of batcher feedback (batch size estimate toggling). could be batching heuristic oversubscribing?

josh: I tried disabling continuous batching for that run (flag `--batcher.continuous=false`), result: p95 dropped from 230->96 ms, tok/s down 7%. so batching interaction is part of it.

vikram: interesting. can you share the flamegraph and cupti traces? I want to check kernel occupancy and memcpy overlap.

perf-bot: artifacts uploaded: https://perf.internal/runs/4312109876/artifacts (flamegraph + cupti + kernels.csv) :white_check_mark:

vikram: grabbing them now. initial look — H100 fused memcpy kernel shows poor overlap, and memcpy appears serialized (no async stream overlap). suspicious.

josh: repro command I used: `./bench_attn --gpu H100 --seq 8192 --bs 8 --kernel paged --kv-warm 1e6 --continuous-batching true`

anya: can you try invoking selector with `--selector-debug=on` so we can see decisions per request? add trace id to console.

josh: will run that next.

maria: also saw higher GPU memory fragmentation on H100 in the kernel that chooses fused memcpy path; free list churn goes up which might trigger different alloc alignment and cause DMA inefficiencies.

vikram: plan: 1) bisect selector change (72f9c8d) to confirm regression 2) run targeted microbench: H100 bs=8 seq 8192 with and without continuous batching, and with `--selector=legacy` vs `auto` 3) instrument memcpy stream submission to force async overlap

anya: assign to @vikram for bisect, and @josh for microbench runs. I'll open PERF ticket. :clipboard:

dev-bot: created ticket PERF-1123: "H100 paged-attn p95 regression bs=8 seq=8192" and linked artifacts.

vikram: starting git bisect now; if it points to kernel-selector policy, we'll add a guard to avoid fused memcpy selection when kvcache eviction rate > 1k/s or batcher inflight > N.

josh: FYI, quick micro-run with selector=legacy on H100 produced tok/s=150k p95=80ms for same params — so selector heuristics definitely involved.

maria: small note — L40S had stable performance; its memcpy paths are using PCIe rules differently (CXL driver quirk?). worth cross-checking with infra.

vikram: will push a temporary patch to selector to bias against fused memcpy on H100 for seq>=4096 and run soak. tagging @maria for memory fragmentation traces.

anya: thanks team. please paste results from the bisect and microbench back into this thread. if we confirm, we should roll a quick hotfix and add a regression test for bs=8 seq=8192 on H100 in CI.

josh: will run selector-debug and attach logs next (expect about 30min).

perf-bot: next scheduled re-run (nightly) will include the selector-guard experiment; monitoring configured.

vikram: bisection update (brief): narrowed down to 72f9c8d..a3f2b1e; reproducer step shows the flip happens after `prefuse->fused-memcpy` heuristic added. more in a follow-up.

josh: thanks — logging off for now, will post selector-debug output tomorrow morning. :wave:
